mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies near Verona City Hall and the moon is in its first quarter. If you are an early riser, the International Space Station will pass overhead for two minutes starting at 4:54 AM; look toward the south southwest over Belleville and watch it travel toward the east northeast across the sky.

The City of Verona has provided updates on the zoning map and ordinance process, allowing residents to use an interactive map to check their property zoning. Additionally, voters are reminded to check their designated polling locations, as two new locations were approved in 2023.

There is plenty to do this weekend, starting with live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, you can join a yoga session tomorrow at Insight Wellness, and catch some trivia on Tuesday at Hop Haus or Wisconsin Brewing Company.

On Thursday, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I after receiving a report of dangerous driving behavior while students were on board; thankfully, no injuries were reported.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Mint Cookie. The store is currently closed, but you can head over to grab a scoop when it opens today at 10:00 AM.
